capabilities: create tasks in TickTick from Obsidian
check TickTick tasks via plugin commands
log into TickTick through plugin settings
extras: README is minimal: only listed feature is creating tasks, plus a note that NodeJS v16+ is needed for development.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or check off tasks in the TickTick service.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates with TickTick, allowing you to easily transform and sync data between TickTick and Obsidian.

summary: TickTick integration that creates tasks in TickTick and checks task status from Obsidian commands.
